direct_tokens.priority: promoter overlap, then loop-linked, then nearest within 50 kb of the canonical TSS

definitions.promoter: [TSS-1000, TSS+1001) around every GENCODE v44 transcript start
definitions.tf_promoter: factor ChIP peak, ATAC peak and target promoter share at least one base
definitions.tf_distal: factor ChIP peak overlaps an ATAC peak in the loop anchor opposite the target promoter
definitions.promoter_contact: promoters of two genes lie in opposite anchors of one Hi-C loop
definitions.shared_element: two genes are loop-linked to the same distal ATAC peak
definitions.methylation: coverage-weighted CpG fraction pooled over WGBS replicates; fewer than 10 reads is unobserved

controls.grn: per-relation degree-preserving double-edge swaps; node features unchanged
controls.direct: token sets reassigned by a permutation of genes that have a locus

caveats: Bulk, unpaired K562 experiments; applying them to RPE1 is cross-cell-line transfer.
Edges are unsigned candidates, not validated regulatory interactions.
Only the ChIP factors already selected by Epi-C3 are used, so factor coverage is narrow.
